episodes.synopsis: Aoi spends most of her time alone, but an old friend from middle school has arrived to make good on an old promise.
episodes.title: Anything but Mountains!

episodes.synopsis: With the help of Hinata's dad, the girls familiarize themselves with the necessary gear to climb.
episodes.title: Let's Go Together!

episodes.synopsis: Hinata convinces Aoi to try climbing a mountain, but Aoi thinks they should start with a small mountain and work their way up to the big ones.
episodes.title: Mountain Climbing Is Dangerous!?

episodes.synopsis: Aoi and Hinata have a camping cook-off.
episodes.title: Showdown! Mountain Cooking!?

episodes.synopsis: Aoi meets a girl from her school who is crazy about backpacking.
episodes.title: What's a Schlafsack?

episodes.synopsis: It's Aoi's turn to pick the mountain, so she calls on her new friend to help.
episodes.title: I'm the One Deciding!?

episodes.synopsis: Aoi picked the mountain but now she needs the right equipment.
episodes.title: Which Daypack Do You Want?

episodes.synopsis: Aoi and Hinata embark on their second climb and meet some interesting people along the way.
episodes.title: Let's Climb Mt. Takao!

episodes.synopsis: Hinata teaches Aoi, mountain manners and learns about giant flying squirrels.
episodes.title: A Forest Girl in the Forest!?

episodes.synopsis: Aoi, Hinata, and Kokona help each other down the mountain.
episodes.title: The Climb Isn't Over Until You Descend!?

episodes.synopsis: In preparation for their next trip, Aoi invites Kokona over to help her cook snacks.
episodes.title: Tomorrow Is Outdoors!

episodes.synopsis: Aoi, Hinata, Kaeda, and Kokona meet up for a picnic at Hannou River.
episodes.title: To the Next Landscape
